content.short: An asset of the interchangeable future of p2p without the intermediation of a third party or a financial institution.
content.description:
Is an active from the future developed in the Cardano´s block network, it is interchangeable from person to person without the third parts intermediary. Global Pay Token Electronic is a version of electronic assets that allows that payments been sent online directly from one part to another without passing through a financial institution.

Our token Global Pay Currency is born with the objective to give the world the possibility of making world trade without going through bureaucracy control to which we are used to, where all the big banks control our money and above all charge very high commissions.

With GPAY Currency you will be able to make transactions any time of the day, buy, sale products and commerce with all types of articles around the world, using only your mobile device to make payments.
